capabilities: Manage Anke projects and character libraries as Markdown files with properties
Organize character portrait variant groups with thumbnails, search, and drag reordering
Insert NGA dice rolls, dialogue coloring, and Chinese punctuation fixes while writing
Copy selected text or the current section as NGA BBCode to the clipboard
Publish sections to a bound NGA thread manually or on a schedule
disambiguation: Not the Anker hardware brand; this manages Anke (dice-driven fiction) writing projects and NGA forum publishing.
extras: The interface is primarily in Chinese. Free, supported by optional WeChat tips. macOS is verified in real use; Windows has not yet been verified on actual machines. Publishing requires uploading images to an image host yourself, since the plugin does not upload images; cookies are stored via Obsidian SecretStorage.
problem: Obsidian has no tooling for Anke forum fiction: tracking character portrait variants per work, inserting forum dice commands, or converting Markdown to NGA BBCode for posting.

relations.evidence: optional NGA publishing sends the chosen section to your bound forum thread using the cookie you provide

summary: Manages Anke dice-driven fiction projects and character portraits in Markdown, and converts or publishes sections to the NGA forum as BBCode.
